# Psalm 85 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 85:4 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Restore-us O-God-of our-salvation, and-annul your-indignation with-us.
- **LOGOS:** Restore us again, O God of our salvation, and put away your indignation toward us!
- **PNEUMA:** Now restore us again, God of our salvation! Let go of your frustration with us.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
